title: Fix Test Event Classification in Compound Shell Commands
description: Fix classifyCommandKind, resolveTestFilesFromCommand, and parseTestInfoFromCommand to handle compound shell commands (cd && go test, npm run && jest, etc.) so test events are correctly identified as agent.tool.test.starting instead of agent.tool.terminal.starting. Also ensure all individual test IDs are listed in the tests field.
summary: Fixed test event classification for compound shell commands. classifyCommandKind now splits by sequence operators and finds the highest-priority kind across segments. Pipe chains handled by checking only first command. Added extractTestSegmentFromCommand helper for resolveTestFilesFromCommand and parseTestInfoFromCommand. All tests pass plus new compound command tests.
